title: Would You Survive the Tutorial?
dek: The System has arrived. You have one hour before the monsters spawn. Let's see how it goes.

outcomes.name: First Clear
outcomes.tagline: You didn't survive the tutorial. You speedran it.
outcomes.description: Everyone else is still reading the welcome message and you've already cleared the final floor, claimed the first-clear bonus and started on the leaderboard. Slow starts are for other people.
outcomes.share_text: I got FIRST CLEAR on the tutorial. Would you survive it?

outcomes.name: The Clever Survivor
outcomes.tagline: You watched, you planned, and you never took a hit you didn't have to.
outcomes.description: While everyone else panicked, you found high ground, studied the monsters and let the heroes learn the hard way. You're alive because you're smart, and readers love an MC who uses their head.
outcomes.watch_out: MCs who win by being lucky and loud.
outcomes.share_text: I survived the tutorial as The Clever Survivor. Would you survive it?

outcomes.name: The One Who Got Everyone Out
outcomes.tagline: Nobody gets left behind. Not on your watch.
outcomes.description: You didn't rank first, and you didn't care. You organized the scared, carried the wounded and walked out with the biggest party in the tutorial. That's a different kind of power.
outcomes.watch_out: MCs who treat allies as disposable.
outcomes.share_text: I was The One Who Got Everyone Out of the tutorial. Would you survive it?

outcomes.name: Hidden Class Unlocked
outcomes.tagline: You found the thing nobody was supposed to find.
outcomes.description: While everyone else fought, you followed the weird glowing rock, the door behind the waterfall and the quest nobody else could see. Now you have a class the System swears doesn't exist.
outcomes.watch_out: Stories where every class is the same.
outcomes.share_text: I got HIDDEN CLASS UNLOCKED in the tutorial. Would you survive it?

outcomes.name: Died Immediately (Respawn Pending)
outcomes.tagline: You pressed the glowing button. Of course you did.
outcomes.description: Good news: this is a very forgiving System. Better news: your death is now the most-watched replay in the tutorial. You read for fun, not trauma, and your books should be as delightful as your respawn animation.
outcomes.share_text: I DIED IMMEDIATELY in the tutorial (respawn pending). Would you survive it?

outcomes.name: Became the Tutorial Boss
outcomes.tagline: Why beat the tutorial when you can run it?
outcomes.description: Somewhere between the first monster and the last floor, you stopped being a participant and started being management. The next batch of survivors is going to have a very bad day.
outcomes.share_text: I BECAME THE TUTORIAL BOSS. Would you survive it?

questions.prompt: A countdown starts. Monsters spawn in one hour. What do you do first?

options.label: Sprint for the spawn point. First kills get bonus XP.
Find high ground and watch what everyone else does.
Gather the scared people and get them organized.
Inspect the weird glowing rock nobody else noticed.
Whichever has the coolest name. Chaos Juggler? Yes.
The one with no description. It's probably fine.
Warrior. Hit things, get stronger, hit bigger things.
Something boring and reliable that nobody else is picking.

questions.prompt: A stranger on your team is about to get eaten. You...

options.label: Dive in. Nobody gets left behind.
Notice the monster's weak spot is glowing. Interesting.
Also get eaten. We're a team.
Negotiate with the monster. It seems reasonable.

questions.prompt: You find a hidden door behind a waterfall. Inside:

options.label: A shortcut to the final floor. Let's go.
An ancient class stone that only works for me.
A throne. It seems to be waiting for someone.
A chest with teeth.

questions.prompt: The tutorial boss has arrived. Your plan?

options.label: Use the terrain, bait its attacks, never take a hit.
Coordinate everyone's skills. We win together.
Unleash the skill I've been secretly leveling all tutorial.
Ask if it's hiring.

questions.prompt: The tutorial rankings are posted. You're...

options.label: #1. By a lot.
Somewhere in the middle, on purpose. Attention is dangerous.
Unranked. I spent the whole time helping other people.
Listed as "deceased (temporarily)."
